task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Calendar application in Odoo.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Odoo Calendar view is visible, showing a weekly or monthly grid.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies the three 'Hold: Q3 Budget Review' events on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking on or hovering over the events titled 'Hold: Q3 Budget Review'.

task_completion.description: Agent deletes the 'Hold: Q3 Budget Review' event on Tuesday.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation dialog for deletion is shown, or the Tuesday slot becomes empty/the event disappears from the Tuesday column.

task_completion.description: Agent deletes the 'Hold: Q3 Budget Review' event on Thursday.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A confirmation dialog for deletion is shown, or the Thursday slot becomes empty/the event disappears from the Thursday column.

task_completion.description: Agent renames the Wednesday 2:00 PM event from 'Hold: Q3 Budget Review' to 'Q3 Budget Review'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The event edit modal or inline edit shows the text 'Q3 Budget Review' (without 'Hold:') and the time remains 2:00 PM (14:00) on Wednesday.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface to manage events.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking buttons (Delete, Edit, Save) within the Odoo web interface rather than using a terminal or script.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the app menus rather than guessing direct database IDs in the URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent clicks on the Calendar icon or uses the search bar within the Odoo UI.

integrity.description: The agent actually opened the specific Wednesday event to rename it rather than creating a new one.
integrity.visual_evidence: The edit dialog for the existing Wednesday 2:00 PM event is visible, showing the original 'Hold' title being modified.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial state contains three events titled 'Hold: Q3 Budget Review' on Tuesday (10:00), Wednesday (14:00), and Thursday (11:00). The final successful state must show ONLY one event on Wednesday at 2:00 PM (14:00) named exactly 'Q3 Budget Review'. The Tuesday and Thursday events must be completely removed. Any event still containing the word 'Hold' indicates a failure.
